propositions: Dependabot PR #125 bundles two dependency bumps (zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0), but only the zizmor bump is safe to land; the mcp 2.0 bump is excluded because it removes mcp.server.fastmcp which is imported in multiple source files.
The zizmor 1.29.0 bump must be landed as a safe subset by editing pyproject.toml and regenerating uv.lock with 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor', leaving mcp pinned at <2 to maintain version 1.29.0.

The mcp 2.0 migration (removal of fastmcp and refactoring of import paths in mcp_server.py, gen_mcp_reference.py, _mcp_auth.py, and _mcp_models.py) is tracked separately under ticket 732b-51df-acf2-477b and must not be conflated with this zizmor-only update.

The change was landed via Gerrit as commit 4bce6a3cca435f9d52dbe2e1969dd08cab605e29 with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, PR #125 was closed with a comment linking the mcp half to ticket 732b, and all acceptance criteria were verified.
